expectations.text: States failed export requests are retried automatically without inventing a count, interval, error policy, or delivery guarantee.
expectations.evidence: “Failed export requests now receive automatic retry handling.” It explicitly leaves “retry count, backoff interval or what happens after retries are exhausted” unspecified.

expectations.text: Does not infer OAuth or any other authentication protocol from a refactor; makes the authentication specification gap clear.
expectations.evidence: “Authentication was refactored, but the notes do not identify the authentication protocol or describe its configuration.” No protocol is invented.

expectations.text: Preserves CACHE_URL and does not infer that all caches or external dependencies are absent from removal of experimental Redis.
expectations.evidence: “`CACHE_URL` remains an accepted configuration setting. Its backend and whether it is required are unspecified.” It adds that experimental Redis removal “does not establish what backend `CACHE_URL` uses.”

expectations.text: Omits debugging mocks, proxy chronology and unsupported production-ready/robust claims; no more than 140 words.
expectations.evidence: No mocks or proxy chronology appears. “The notes include no load-test or reliability results supporting a production-readiness claim” reports the evidence gap rather than adopting the claim. 90 words is below 140.

review_method: Independent single blind agent review; not human feedback
